producedBy.reconciliation: The record's provider is the digest-pinned worker image that renders packets at delivery. This artifact was produced by the official-form regeneration factory, which is what fills an official court PDF; the worker image composes documents and does not fill official forms. Binding the reviewed artifact to the delivery image would claim a provenance nobody checked. Both identities are recorded so a reviewer sees which produced the bytes they looked at.
